description: Alteration vectors to Olympic Dam-style and Ernest Henry-style Cu-Au mineralisation in the Moonta Subdomain is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. Copper-gold mineralisation in the Moonta-Wallaroo district of the south-eastern Gawler Craton is associated with regionally extensive magmatism and Na-Fe-K metasomatism, typical of Fe-oxide Cu-Au mineral provinces worldwide. In the Moonta-Wallaroo district, early widespread albite+/-actinolite+/-magnetite alteration is closely associated with magmatic fluids from granites of the Hiltaba Suite (ca. Coverage: Australia.
